caseNameFull: Forney v. Apfel, Commissioner of Social Security

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 522 U. S. 1072.] Motion of the Solicitor General for divided argument granted to be divided as follows: petitioner, 15 minutes; the Solicitor General, 15 minutes; amicus curiae in support of the judgment below, 80 minutes.
